title: The Grand Inquisitor
description: The Grand Inquisitor led the Sith-trained hunters that tracked down Jedi who had escaped from Order 66. He found the Third Sister's obsession with Obi-Wan Kenobi troubling. The Grand Inquisitor had Kenobi cornered when the Third Sister ran him through with her LIghtsaber. To Reva's surprise, the Grand Inquisitor returned at the side of Darth Vader.
